svg.aria-label: One signal, end to end: signal, adapter, ingress, Agent, monitor
svg.title: One signal, end to end: signal, adapter, ingress, Agent, monitor
svg.desc: A line with five stations. 01, signal: a hook fires, a frame arrives, a log grows. 02, adapter: decoded tolerantly, normalized by category. 03, ingress: validated, deduplicated, given a sequence. 04, Agent: state, status and typed events. 05, monitor: a store, React hooks and views. A dotted line runs back from the Agent to the adapter: prompts and answers go back by a service, never as an event.
